theme: A wide-open Friday for the decisions that keep slipping.
greeting: Barely anything on the calendar today, Dan — a haircut at 3:30 and otherwise open. A good window for the travel calls that have been drifting, with the Black Keys tomorrow to look forward to.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: p1 on the Mike + Dan board, due Sept 14 and still open. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — a refundable hold now removes the risk, dates adjustable later.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and the book-by is Oct 15, six days out. All four kids, Dec 13–Jan 2; holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year, so the domestic shortlist is the safe default.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week window to drive the Pathfinder Portland → St Pete is live right now; booking the one hotel night is the only open piece once dates are set.

flagged.title: Valoris agreement from Mike Lubrano
flagged.detail: The fully-executed Valoris operating agreement, a joinder, and a revised Exhibit A arrived Monday and are still unread — worth a look given it's governance work in your lane.

inbox.noise: One markets newsletter is the only other new mail.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Autumn's winter squash and cipolline onions are at their sweetest now, perfect for slow roasting.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before afternoon — the clearest stretch of the week for the overdue travel decisions.
Just the 3:30 haircut breaks up the afternoon; the rest is yours.
An open night in, with the Black Keys at the State Theatre on deck for tomorrow.
